Name: Horror Lewis Behelit
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
Do you love Berserk? Or perhaps you enjoy the horror genre? 

FYI: A Behelit, from Berserk (manga/anime) is an egg shaped artifact with facial features that move around, that allows an individual to achieve their deepest desires in exchange for their humanity.

[size=4]This is a body horror mod of Lewis!!! [/size]
(Body horror often involves the grotesque transformation or distortion of the human body or the incorporation of unsettling biological elements. The idea of an egg-like object with facial features that exhibit movement can evoke feelings of discomfort and unease, especially if the features are exaggerated or unsettling in appearance. This aligns with the themes of body horror, which often explores the fragility and malleability of the body, as well as the fear of the unknown or the unnatural)

I really love Berserk and when this random idea popped into my head, I just had to make it happen. it's something I needed for my playthrough, and Idk how many of you will also like this but it certainly adds some excitement to Lewis' character! 

it is vanilla lewis dialogue in the promotional images above, just the portraits make it seem much more ominous haha!

[size=5]FEATURES:
[/size]-6 extremely creepy portraits
-Lewis' boxers on his beach sprites
-He wears socks in the winter time

[size=4]HOW TO INSTALL:
[/size]1. ensure you have content patcher + SMAPI
2. download my file
3. unzip my file into your 'mods' folder
